purpose: Compare figure payloads from all twelve fresh IDAES 2.12 regional solutions with the archived workbook and printed article labels, without substituting archived data for a fresh solve.

stream_table_absolute.note: Absolute maximum includes stream pressure in Pa; use material relative comparison across different physical units.

EF-7.basis: Fresh detailed stream values closely match the archived workbook but the printed label does not.

EF-10.basis: The fresh solution has measurable detailed drift from the archived workbook; do not attribute its printed-label miss solely to the known publication snapshot difference.

printed_figure_6_emissions: All twelve fresh regional cases retain the documented EMISSIONS-NORMALIZATION-001 difference from printed upstream and process labels.
conclusion: Every regional quantitative figure input can now be extracted from an accepted fresh modern solution. This does not assert byte-identical PDFs or that the printed publication snapshot is identical to the surviving workbook; EF-10 detailed drift remains a distinct modern solver-path discrepancy.
